name: @sos-2/harness-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 Harness Contracts Acceptance Suites (Work Order P5): the acceptance proof of the harness protocol + body broker + execution fabric. A fake/reference body (a complete in-memory implementation of the §9 HarnessContract: workspace, shell, browser where advertised, git, artifacts, observations, events) executes a COMPLETE bounded task through the public contract surface — create -> workspace write -> shell exec -> git commit -> artifacts capture -> observations emit -> complete. The suites pin every P5 acceptance criterion: capabilities are explicit and provider-neutral; body lease expiry/revocation fails closed; a body cannot mint authority (negative tests: forged authority payloads rejected with typed denials); provider/vendor identity never becomes SOS semantic identity; body replacement preserves task identity (kill mid-task -> new body -> resume -> same task id, same durable state). Structural scans pin ZERO new external dependencies (workspace :* + the existing toolchain only) and offline determinism (no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env in the owned package sources).
